notes: Stored complete reports only. Comparison-population hashes include physical scene/settings, recorded clips, scoring version and wrong-fix target, not just reused scene IDs. Metrics recomputed with current aggregation from stored scores; inference is unchanged. Different hashes are not a longitudinal regression comparison. Dirty producers retain their original code hash.

risk_coverage.definition: Scene risk = any wrong/unmatched emitted fix. Rank by worst emitted confidence; equal-confidence groups stay together. Step integral over all scenes; unanswered tail costs 1. Mean metre error is unavailable if an unmatched hypothesis has unknown error.
